entries.summary: Added isolated internal pure validation core with own-property create/update materialization, bounded iterative indexing, structural/type/reference/compatibility rules, deterministic provisional result metadata, inert executable-looking values, and focused adversarial Mocha coverage.

Applied bounded audit corrections: cap diagnostic production during rule and traversal execution, preserve invalid outcomes after truncation, use the approved unsupported outcome, stop version-specific validation for unsupported schema versions, sanitize schema metadata, enforce finite/bounded numeric and scalar yes/no value semantics, and report the actual FastFill diagnostic path.

Re-audited against fulcrumapp/fulcrum revision 25503ce61df71e9932c2ecef4bde348780afb15d and corrected condition vocabulary/field_key handling, repeatable and data-name scopes, title flattening, field-specific Rails attributes and bounds, Photo FastFill parsing, form-level field effects, status enablement, ProjectField rejection, bounded malformed traversal, input-only outcomes, and package deep-import isolation.
Aligned optional Rails-blank status and condition values, prevented numeric condition field keys from coercing to string keys, and covered those boundaries in focused tests.

Closed the remaining package-boundary and own-property gaps: excluded internal validation sources from npm package contents and generated dist, ignored inherited status-field enablement, and tested both deep-import boundaries.

Applied remaining audit parity corrections: valid outcomes now require completion of the internal requested pure-check profile, requested gaps distinguish incomplete from unavailable, numeric Text defaults no longer claim an unsupported Rails rule, Yes/No false values follow Rails present semantics, blank choice-list and length values follow the parity profile, and Sketch backgrounds enforce only the evidenced array shape. Corrected Rails Form::TYPES evidence to 24 and verified package boundaries.

Closed four remaining audit parity blockers: valid/invalid outcomes are separated from full coverage claims and requested unavailable checks become unsupported, choice_list_id branch selection follows Ruby truthiness, optional lengths follow Ruby truthiness while preserving zero validation, and Sketch backgrounds accepts null while requiring arrays for non-null values without inspecting members.

Aligned result orchestration with the shared coordinator: contextual, provisional, skipped, and otherwise incomplete coverage can never produce valid; the minimal form is incomplete, while makeResult can report valid only for an explicitly complete pure profile without hiding contextual checks.

Applied four guarded review fixes: reject non-string ai_prompt values without coercion, emit exactly one diagnostic for each malformed required common boolean, centralize the diagnostic cap, and construct bounded JSON Pointer segments without user-defined coercion.

Implemented the approved FLCRM-22116 v1 public validateForm(request) adapter for complete form artifacts, exact coverage/version envelope, namespaced JSONPath diagnostics, compatibility-only previous_artifact handling, canonical fixture parity, and compiled package/browser integration.

Applied the user-authorized narrow current-head review corrections: blank or unobserved schema metadata now remains null, validator provenance no longer hard-codes the package version, Rails-present handling treats empty arrays and objects as blank, diagnostic overflow metadata is enumerable and preserved through truncation, and dangling-else indentation was normalized. Added adversarial tests and the pinned validation contract document.
